description: Capital moving from vault to vault: the routes ranked by capital moved, how many addresses moved it, agents apart, how strongly each move is linked (transaction, amount-matched, likely), what the moves looked like when they happened (yield promised against paid, what changed in the vault left, the result since against staying), and the vaults gaining and losing, over a week, month, quarter or year. Pass from and to for one route’s analysis: the two vaults at the move, what preceded it, the result since and the overlap (paid; the month’s largest route open). A migration is a withdrawal followed within 72 hours by a deposit into another vault by the same address. FREE for the routes, grades and findings.

from.description: With to: the source vault id of one route (from a route in routes).

to.description: With from: the destination vault id of one route.

who.description: Whose capital to rank the routes by: all (default), people (addresses not identified as agent-linked) or agents.

window.description: The period: week, month (default), quarter or year.

name: vault_capital_migration

cascades.description: Waves of exits: a large exit and who left the same vault after it, agents apart.

findings.description: What the moves looked like when they happened, capital-weighted over the largest routes.

leavingChanges.description: What changed in the vaults capital is leaving, over 1 to 90 days.

means.description: What counts as a migration and what is left out.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

movers.description: Who is moving: first, repeat and frequent movers, vaults held, the largest movers.

overlap.description: How much of the busiest vaults’ allocations is the same markets.

routes.description: Vault-to-vault routes by capital moved, each with evidenceUsd by grade.

totals.description: Capital moved, migrations, addresses, people and agents apart.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Capital moving between vaults
